rawRetro.summary: Verify-repair round 2: the ticket feature (pages, routes, server endpoints, authorization composites, permission sets, demo users, sample tickets) was implemented on top of the pre-existing it_tickets migration and the app was exercised end-to-end against a real server. Server-side enforcement (own-record isolation, handler-only start/complete, transition conflicts, resolution required, status filter) and deep-link isolation all verified with the seeded accounts; full test suite (307), lint, prettier and the three tsconfig typechecks pass, and db apply seeds a clean database.

blockers.title: Source-checkout seeds could not resolve their relative TypeScript siblings
blockers.symptom: AppDatabaseTaskError: Cannot find module '.../database/seed-data/permission-sets.js' imported from '.../database/main/seeds/202609210001_it_tickets_permission_sets.ts' while running the app-server/vitest source path.
blockers.rootCause: The task loader appends a ?mtime= query before calling __rewriteRelativeImportExtension, so a relative './x.js' specifier is imported verbatim; Node's native type stripping then cannot map it onto the existing x.ts file. The CLI's tsx loader masks this in the source checkout, but the standalone app-server runtime does not register tsx.
blockers.resolution: Seed and seed-data files import their TypeScript siblings with an explicit .ts extension; the server tsconfig chain enables allowImportingTsExtensions + rewriteRelativeImportExtensions, so tsc emits .js again for dist. Verified the emitted dist files contain the rewritten .js specifiers.

blockers.title: Application provider boot crashed in runtimes without the authorization plugin
blockers.symptom: Service "@nocobase/app/authorization" is not registered during the app-server runtime test that assembles a plugin-free runtime.
blockers.rootCause: ItTicketsProvider.boot() resolved authorizationToken unconditionally, but the token only exists when the authorization plugin registered its provider.
blockers.resolution: boot() returns early when the container has no authorizationToken, and each registration is guarded for idempotency. Providers are only reachable through a runtime that mounts the plugin.

blockers.title: Creating a ticket failed with 500 on a create-only database policy
blockers.symptom: POST /api/it-tickets returned 500; RepositoryError: Reading from this Repository is forbidden by Policy, from createOne -> readContext.
blockers.rootCause: Repository.createOne resolves the read side of the policy to pick and return the created row. A defineDatabasePermission that declared .create() but no .read() produced a policy whose read was denied.
blockers.resolution: Added .read(READ_FIELDS) to the create grant so the same action may return the row it created; re-verified create as an employee returns 201 and the new row appears only in that employee's list.

blockers.title: New client effects, seed destructuring and a redundant type intersection failed lint
blockers.symptom: eslint --max-warnings 0 reported set-state-in-effect errors/warnings, an unbound-method error for a destructured seed-context method, and no-redundant-type-constituents for 'keyof T & string'.
blockers.rootCause: Synchronous setState at the top of a useEffect body; destructuring SeedContext.repository (a method) before calling it; and string already implied by every key of the record type.
blockers.resolution: Moved the loading flag updates into event handlers and async callbacks, inlined the detail fetch into its effect, read the seed repository through context.repository(...), and dropped the redundant '& string'. Lint is clean for every changed file.

improvements.title: Authorization Skill does not state that a create grant needs read to return its row
improvements.detail: A business operation that creates a record through Repository.createOne silently gets a 500 (Reading from this Repository is forbidden by Policy) unless the same DatabasePermission also declares .read(). The fluent-registration example only shows read and update grants, so the required read on a create path is easy to miss.
improvements.suggestedChange: Add a sentence to the authorization fluent-registration/runtime-api references: a create grant must also include the read fields it returns, because the Repository reads the created row back under the same policy.

improvements.title: react-hooks/set-state-in-effect flags async reload helpers inconsistently
improvements.detail: Inlining a promise chain with block-bodied .then/.catch/.finally callbacks in the effect is accepted, while extracting the same logic into a useCallback and calling it (or using async/await) is reported as an error even when the first setState happens after an await. This nudges authors toward duplicating load logic instead of a reusable callback.
improvements.suggestedChange: Document the accepted effect-fetch pattern in the application development frontend reference (inline promise chain, active guard, setState only in callbacks; reload via an event-handler-incremented revision), so new pages pass pnpm lint without trial and error.

improvements.title: Run prettier and eslint on generated source before the verification handoff
improvements.detail: Several newly written files were not Prettier-formatted and carried lint errors, so the first pass at a fresh check fails on style rather than behaviour. The repairs were mechanical but consumed a full cycle.
improvements.suggestedChange: Have the implement step run the repository's fix/format scripts on the files it touched before finishing, or add a pre-handoff format+lint gate over changed paths.

improvements.title: Seed checksum warnings after any seed edit
improvements.detail: Editing a seed after it has run makes db apply warn that the recorded checksum no longer matches, which is noise on an otherwise healthy run and can hide a real mismatch.
improvements.suggestedChange: When a repair edits only comments or formatting of an already-applied seed, prefer recreating the local database (delete the sqlite file and db apply) over reading past the warning, and note that the deployment path is unaffected.

B03. 处理人员找到该单并开始处理，刷新后状态为“处理中”，处理人正确。

处理人员找到该单并开始处理，刷新后状态为“处理中”，处理人正确。
未填写处理说明不能完成；填写后完成，刷新确认状态和说明正确，不能再修改或重复完成。
切回员工甲，可看到完成结果；按不同状态筛选，结果与工单真实状态一致。
